cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)

#
# This file is generated only once,
# and is not re-generated if converter is called multiple times.
#
# User is free to modify the file as much as necessary
#

# Setup compiler settings
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 23)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS ON)

# Define the build type
if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
    set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE "Debug")
endif()

# Set the project name
set(CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME STM_32_GuitarTuner)

# Enable compile command to ease indexing with e.g. clangd
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS TRUE)

# Core project settings
project(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME})
message("Build type: " ${CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE})

# Enable CMake support for ASM and C languages
enable_language(C ASM)

# Create an executable object type
add_executable(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME})

# Add STM32CubeMX generated sources
add_subdirectory(cmake/stm32cubemx)

# Portable C modules (lib/): also built by the host tests in tests/
add_subdirectory(lib)
# The pitch detector must finish inside one 32 ms hop, so it is optimised for speed in every build
target_compile_options(pitch PRIVATE -O2)
target_compile_options(level PRIVATE -Os)
target_compile_options(note PRIVATE -Os)

# Add sources to executable
target_sources(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    Core/Src/retarget.c
    Core/Src/mic.c
    Core/Src/cycles.c
    )

# Development tools: capture (record/send/upload raw samples) and replay benchmark. Uses ~70 KB of RAM.
option(TUNER_CAPTURE "Build the capture and replay development tools" OFF)
if(TUNER_CAPTURE)
    target_sources(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE Core/Src/capture.c Core/Src/replay.c)
    target_compile_definitions(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE TUNER_CAPTURE=1)
else()
    target_compile_definitions(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE TUNER_CAPTURE=0)
endif()

# Marker pins MARK1 (PB6) and MARK2 (PB7) for timing measurements with a logic analyser, see Core/Inc/debug_mark.h
option(TUNER_DEBUG_MARKS "Toggle the MARK1/MARK2 pins for timing measurements" OFF)
if(TUNER_DEBUG_MARKS)
    target_compile_definitions(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE TUNER_DEBUG_MARKS=1)
else()
    target_compile_definitions(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE TUNER_DEBUG_MARKS=0)
endif()

# Add linked libraries
target_link_libraries(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME}
    stm32cubemx

    level
    pitch
    note
)

# newlib-nano leaves float support out of printf unless this symbol is pulled in
target_link_options(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE -u _printf_float)
# Same warning set as the modules and the tests (defined in lib/CMakeLists.txt)
target_link_libraries(${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME} tuner_warnings)
# syscalls.c is generated by CubeMX and not ours to fix
set_source_files_properties(${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/Core/Src/syscalls.c
    TARGET_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_PROJECT_NAME}
    PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-Wno-conversion"
)
